Toulouse Street is the second studio album by American rock band the Doobie Brothers.
It was released in July 1972, by Warner Bros.
It was the band's first album with bassist Tiran Porter and also the first with drummer Michael Hossack to augment existing drummer John Hartman, putting in place their trademark twin-drummer sound.
